title: Secret in Great-Grandfather’s Wine Gourd
synopsis: A young boy finds out about a family secret.

fullText.simplified:
太爷爷酒葫芦里的秘密

    我的家族里有个大英雄，他就是我的太爷爷！因为在过去那个吃不饱，穿不暖的年代，是我太爷爷用自己的努力养活了上上下下好几十口人。
    我们这些年轻人从小就是听着太爷爷的故事长大的。关于他的一切我们不仅能张口就来，甚至能倒背如流！我的同辈们都以太爷爷为荣，我也是。但是我最好奇的是他腰上挂了几十年都舍不得摘下来的酒葫芦，他竟然连睡觉时都挂在身上！我小时候问过爸爸和爷爷，他们都说不清楚原因。而且爷爷一再嘱咐我不要打太爷爷酒葫芦的主意，否则他会生气的。
    随着我年龄的增大，我的好奇心不但没有减少，反而还越来越强了。终于在我16岁的时候，我趁太爷爷睡着了，偷偷摘下了他的酒葫芦。打开以后，我大吃一惊。因为里面除了一块小石头，什么都没有，连一滴酒都没有。就在我发愣的工夫，太爷爷醒了。看到醒了的太爷爷，我心里七上八下的，有点儿不知所措。但是他先看了看我手里的酒葫芦，又看了看发呆的我，突然笑了，然后说：“小子，我等了这么多年，终于等到摘我酒葫芦的人了。”太爷爷的话让我更糊涂了，他说什么呢？我怎么听不明白？
    太爷爷拍拍他身边的位置，让我坐到他身边，像自言自语一样讲起了酒葫芦的故事。
他年轻的时候，还是个靠天吃饭的年代。有一年大旱，好几个月都没有下雨。庄稼都被旱死了，没有足够的食物导致很多人都被饿死了。我们的家族是个大家庭，有好几十口人，其中还有孕妇和刚出生不久的小宝宝。家里的年轻男人看着饿得哇哇大哭的孩子和吃不上饭的孕妇非常着急。太爷爷这时站出来，告诉大家不能干等着，需要主动出去找食物。因为村子靠山，他打算带家里的小伙子们去山上碰碰运气。
    听说山上有猛兽很危险。人们常说：喝酒壮胆。为了不让自己害怕，太爷爷挂上了家里的酒葫芦，然后就带着十多个年轻人上山了。上山以后，他们开始寻找，慢慢地就发现了很多食物：耐旱的植物、饿死的动物什么的。他们非常高兴，把带来的袋子都装得满满的，但是谁都没注意到天已经黑了下来。就在他们装完准备下山的时候，他们发现天黑了。他们没办法分清方向，找不到来时的路了。每个人都很着急。这时，太爷爷告诉大家别慌，因为他在来的时候，一边走一边丢下小石头做了记号，大家只要耐心寻找小石头，跟着石头走就可以下山了。人们冷静以后，开始寻找，果然找到了小石头，并且很快下了山。太爷爷到山下后，拿走了最后一块小石头，并把它放进了酒葫芦里。他想把这种遇事不慌张，喜欢挑战和勇敢的精神传给家族里最优秀的人。
    太爷爷的做法不仅救了山上的人，也救了家里的人们，所以大家都非常佩服他。因为人们都很敬重他，所以虽然人们对他的酒葫芦感到好奇，但是没人敢问，也没人有勇气找到酒葫芦的秘密。今天，我偷拿了他的酒葫芦，代表我是敢于挑战而且是愿意尝试的人，所以他决定告诉我酒葫芦的秘密，并把酒葫芦给了我，希望我在成长的路上继续保持好奇和探索的精神。
    听完太爷爷的话，我心里美美的，这不就意味着我是家族里最优秀的人吗？

太爺爺酒葫蘆裡的秘密

    我的家族裡有個大英雄，他就是我的太爺爺！因為在過去那個吃不飽，穿不暖的年代，是我太爺爺用自己的努力養活了上上下下好幾十口人。
    我們這些年輕人從小就是聽著太爺爺的故事長大的。關於他的一切我們不僅能張口就來，甚至能倒背如流！我的同輩們都以太爺爺為榮，我也是。但是我最好奇的是他腰上掛了幾十年都捨不得摘下來的酒葫蘆，他竟然連睡覺時都掛在身上！我小時候問過爸爸和爺爺，他們都說不清楚原因。而且爺爺一再囑咐我不要打太爺爺酒葫蘆的主意，否則他會生氣的。
    隨著我年齡的增大，我的好奇心不但沒有減少，反而還越來越強了。終於在我16歲的時候，我趁太爺爺睡著了，偷偷摘下了他的酒葫蘆。打開以後，我大吃一驚。因為裡面除了一塊小石頭，什麼都沒有，連一滴酒都沒有。就在我發愣的工夫，太爺爺醒了。看到醒了的太爺爺，我心裡七上八下的，有點兒不知所措。但是他先看了看我手裡的酒葫蘆，又看了看發呆的我，突然笑了，然後說：“小子，我等了這麼多年，終於等到摘我酒葫蘆的人了。”太爺爺的話讓我更糊塗了，他說什麼呢？我怎麼聽不明白？
    太爺爺拍拍他身邊的位置，讓我坐到他身邊，像自言自語一樣講起了酒葫蘆的故事。
他年輕的時候，還是個靠天吃飯的年代。有一年大旱，好幾個月都沒有下雨。莊稼都被旱死了，沒有足夠的食物導致很多人都被餓死了。我們的家族是個大家庭，有好幾十口人，其中還有孕婦和剛出生不久的小寶寶。家裡的年輕男人看著餓得哇哇大哭的孩子和吃不上飯的孕婦非常著急。太爺爺這時站出來，告訴大家不能乾等著，需要主動出去找食物。因為村子靠山，他打算帶家裡的小伙子們去山上碰碰運氣。
    聽說山上有猛獸很危險。人們常說：喝酒壯膽。為了不讓自己害怕，太爺爺掛上了家裡的酒葫蘆，然後就帶著十多個年輕人上山了。上山以後，他們開始尋找，慢慢地就發現了很多食物：耐旱的植物、餓死的動物甚麼的。他們非常高興，把帶來的袋子都裝得滿滿的，但是誰都沒注意到天已經黑了下來。就在他們裝完準備下山的時候，他們發現天黑了。他們沒辦法分清方向，找不到來時的路了。每個人都很著急。這時，太爺爺告訴大家別慌，因為他在來的時候，一邊走一邊丟下小石頭做了記號，大家只要耐心尋找小石頭，跟著石頭走就可以下山了。人們冷靜以後，開始尋找，果然找到了小石頭，並且很快下了山。太爺爺到山下後，拿走了最後一塊小石頭，並把它放進了酒葫蘆裡。他想把這種遇事不慌張，喜歡挑戰和勇敢的精神傳給家族裡最優秀的人。
    太爺爺的做法不僅救了山上的人，也救了家裡的人們，所以大家都非常佩服他。因為人們都很敬重他，所以雖然人們對他的酒葫蘆感到好奇，但是沒人敢問，也沒人有勇氣找到酒葫蘆的秘密。今天，我偷拿了他的酒葫蘆，代表我是敢於挑戰而且是願意嘗試的人，所以他決定告訴我酒葫蘆的秘密，並把酒葫蘆給了我，希望我在成長的路上繼續保持好奇和探索的精神。
    聽完太爺爺的話，我心裡美美的，這不就意味著我是家族裡最優秀的人嗎？

sentences.english: Great-grandfather then stepped forward and told everyone that they couldn't just sit around waiting.

sentences.simplified: 因为村子靠山，他打算带家里的小伙子们去山上碰碰运气。
sentences.traditional: 因為村子靠山，他打算帶家裡的小伙子們去山上碰碰運氣。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi cūn zi kào shān tā dǎ suàn dài jiā lǐ de xiǎo huǒ zi men qù shān shang pèng pèng yùn qi
sentences.english: They must take the initiative to go out and find food.
Because the village was close to a mountain, he planned to take the young men of the family up the mountain to try their luck.

sentences.simplified: 听说山上有猛兽很危险。
sentences.traditional: 聽說山上有猛獸很危險。
sentences.pinyin: tīng shuō shān shang yǒu měng shòu hěn wēi xiǎn

sentences.simplified: 人们常说：喝酒壮胆。
sentences.traditional: 人們常說：喝酒壯膽。
sentences.pinyin: rén men cháng shuō hē jiǔ zhuàng dǎn
sentences.english: It was said that the mountain had fierce animals and was dangerous.

sentences.simplified: 为了不让自己害怕，太爷爷挂上了家里的酒葫芦，
sentences.traditional: 為了不讓自己害怕，太爺爺掛上了家裡的酒葫蘆，
sentences.pinyin: wèi le bú ràng zì jǐ hài pà tài yé yé guà shàng le jiā lǐ de jiǔ hú lu
sentences.english: It is often said that drinking gives you courage.

sentences.simplified: 然后就带着十多个年轻人上山了。
sentences.traditional: 然後就帶著十多個年輕人上山了。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu jiù dài zhe shí duō ge nián qīng rén shàng shān le
sentences.english: In order not to be afraid, Great-grandfather hung a wine gourd from home on him.

sentences.simplified: 上山以后，他们开始寻找，慢慢地就发现了很多食物：耐旱的植物、饿死的动物什么的。
sentences.traditional: 上山以後，他們開始尋找，慢慢地就發現了很多食物：耐旱的植物、餓死的動物甚麼的。
sentences.pinyin: shàng shān yǐ hòu tā men kāi shǐ xún zhǎo màn man de jiù fā xiàn le hěn duō shí wù nài hàn de zhí wù è sǐ de dòng wù shén me de
sentences.english: Then he took more than a dozen young people up the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 他们非常高兴，把带来的袋子都装得满满的，但是谁都没注意到天已经黑了下来。
sentences.traditional: 他們非常高興，把帶來的袋子都裝得滿滿的，但是誰都沒注意到天已經黑了下來。
sentences.pinyin: tā men fēi cháng gāo xìng bǎ dài lái de dài zi dōu zhuāng de mǎn mǎn de dàn shì shéi dōu méi zhù yì dào tiān yǐ jīng hēi le xià lai
sentences.english: After going up the mountain, they started looking and slowly found a lot of food: drought-resistant plants, starved animals, and so on.

sentences.simplified: 就在他们装完准备下山的时候，他们发现天黑了。
sentences.traditional: 就在他們裝完準備下山的時候，他們發現天黑了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài tā men zhuāng wán zhǔn bèi xià shān de shí hou tā men fā xiàn tiān hēi le
sentences.english: They were very happy and filled all the bags they had brought with them. However, no one noticed that it was already getting dark.

sentences.simplified: 他们没办法分清方向，找不到来时的路了。每个人都很着急。
sentences.traditional: 他們沒辦法分清方向，找不到來時的路了。每個人都很著急。
sentences.pinyin: tā men méi bàn fǎ fēn qīng fāng xiàng zhǎo bu dào lái shí de lù le měi ge rén dōu hěn zháo jí
sentences.english: After they finished loading and were getting ready to go down the mountain, they noticed that it was already dark.

sentences.simplified: 这时，太爷爷告诉大家别慌，因为他在来的时候，一边走一边丢下小石头做了记号，
sentences.traditional: 這時，太爺爺告訴大家別慌，因為他在來的時候，一邊走一邊丟下小石頭做了記號，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí tài yé yé gào su dà jiā bié huāng yīn wèi tā zài lái de shí hou yì biān zǒu yì biān diū xià xiǎo shí tou zuò le jì hao
sentences.english: They had no way to tell the direction and couldn't find the way they came. Everyone was very anxious.

sentences.simplified: 大家只要耐心寻找小石头，跟着石头走就可以下山了。
sentences.traditional: 大家只要耐心尋找小石頭，跟著石頭走就可以下山了。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā zhǐ yào nài xīn xún zhǎo xiǎo shí tou gēn zhe shí tou zǒu jiù kě yǐ xià shān le
sentences.english: At this point, Great-grandfather told everyone not to panic because on the way he had left small stones to mark the way as he walked.

sentences.simplified: 人们冷静以后，开始寻找，果然找到了小石头，并且很快下了山。
sentences.traditional: 人們冷靜以後，開始尋找，果然找到了小石頭，並且很快下了山。
sentences.pinyin: rén men lěng jìng yǐ hòu kāi shǐ xún zhǎo guǒ rán zhǎo dào le xiǎo shí tou bìng qiě hěn kuài xià le shān
sentences.english: Everyone just needed to patiently look for the small stones and follow the stones down the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 太爷爷到山下后，拿走了最后一块小石头，并把它放进了酒葫芦里。
sentences.traditional: 太爺爺到山下後，拿走了最後一塊小石頭，並把它放進了酒葫蘆裡。
sentences.pinyin: tài yé yé dào shān xià hòu ná zǒu le zuì hòu yí kuài xiǎo shí tou bìng bǎ tā fàng jìn le jiǔ hú lu lǐ
sentences.english: After everyone calmed down and started looking, they, sure enough, found the small stones and quickly went down the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 他想把这种遇事不慌张，
sentences.traditional: 他想把這種遇事不慌張，
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng bǎ zhè zhǒng yù shì bù huāng zhāng
sentences.english: When Great-grandfather arrived at the foot of the mountain, he took the last small stone and put it in the wine gourd.

sentences.simplified: 喜欢挑战和勇敢的精神传给家族里最优秀的人。
sentences.traditional: 喜歡挑戰和勇敢的精神傳給家族裡最優秀的人。
sentences.pinyin: xǐ huan tiǎo zhàn hé yǒng gǎn de jīng shén chuán gěi jiā zú lǐ zuì yōu xiù de rén
sentences.english: He wanted to pass on the spirit of not getting flustered when problems occur, ..
.. enjoying challenges, and being brave to the most outstanding person in the family.

sentences.simplified: 太爷爷的做法不仅救了山上的人，也救了家里的人们，所以大家都非常佩服他。
sentences.traditional: 太爺爺的做法不僅救了山上的人，也救了家裡的人們，所以大家都非常佩服他。
sentences.pinyin: tài yé yé de zuò fǎ bù jǐn jiù le shān shang de rén yě jiù le jiā lǐ de rén men suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu fēi cháng pèi fú tā

sentences.simplified: 因为人们都很敬重他，所以虽然人们对他的酒葫芦感到好奇，
sentences.traditional: 因為人們都很敬重他，所以雖然人們對他的酒葫蘆感到好奇，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi rén men dōu hěn jìng zhòng tā suǒ yǐ suī rán rén men duì tā de jiǔ hú lu gǎn dào hào qí
sentences.english: Great-grandfather not only saved the people on the mountain, but also the people at home, so everyone admired him very much.

sentences.simplified: 但是没人敢问，也没人有勇气找到酒葫芦的秘密。
sentences.traditional: 但是沒人敢問，也沒人有勇氣找到酒葫蘆的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì méi rén gǎn wèn yě méi rén yǒu yǒng qì zhǎo dào jiǔ hú lu de mì mì
sentences.english: Because people respected him, although they were curious about his wine gourd, ..

sentences.simplified: 今天，我偷拿了他的酒葫芦，代表我是敢于挑战而且是愿意尝试的人，
sentences.traditional: 今天，我偷拿了他的酒葫蘆，代表我是敢於挑戰而且是願意嘗試的人，
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ tōu ná le tā de jiǔ hú lu dài biǎo wǒ shì gǎn yú tiǎo zhàn ér qiě shì yuàn yì cháng shì de rén
sentences.english: .. no one dared to ask, and no one had the courage to find out the secret of the wine gourd.

sentences.simplified: 所以他决定告诉我酒葫芦的秘密，
sentences.traditional: 所以他決定告訴我酒葫蘆的秘密，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā jué dìng gào su wǒ jiǔ hú lu de mì mì
sentences.english: Today, I secretly took his wine gourd, showing that I am a person who dares to take on challenges and is willing to try things.

sentences.simplified: 并把酒葫芦给了我，希望我在成长的路上继续保持好奇和探索的精神。
sentences.traditional: 並把酒葫蘆給了我，希望我在成長的路上繼續保持好奇和探索的精神。
sentences.pinyin: bìng bǎ jiǔ hú lu gěi le wǒ xī wàng wǒ zài chéng zhǎng de lù shang jì xù bǎo chí hào qí hé tàn suǒ de jīng shén
sentences.english: So he decided to tell me the secret of the wine gourd.
He also gave the wine gourd to me, hoping that I will continue to maintain a curious and explorative spirit as I grow up.

sentences.simplified: 听完太爷爷的话，我心里美美的，
sentences.traditional: 聽完太爺爺的話，我心裡美美的，
sentences.pinyin: tīng wán tài yé yé de huà wǒ xīn li měi měi de

sentences.simplified: 这不就意味着我是家族里最优秀的人吗？
sentences.traditional: 這不就意味著我是家族裡最優秀的人嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè bú jiù yì wèi zhe wǒ shì jiā zú lǐ zuì yōu xiù de rén ma
sentences.english: After hearing what Great-grandfather said, I was very pleased with myself.

sentence_translations: Secret in Great-Grandfather's Wine Gourd
There's a big hero in my family, and he's my great-grandfather!
Because in the past, when there was not enough food to eat and not enough clothes to keep warm, ..
.. it was my great-grandfather's own efforts that provided for several dozen people old and young.
We young people grew up listening to stories about our great-grandfather.
Not only can we tell every story about him, we know them by heart!
Everyone in my generation is proud of Great-grandfather, and so am I.
But I was most curious about the wine gourd that had been hanging from his waist for decades without him taking it off.
It even hung on his body while he slept!
I asked my father and grandfather when I was a kid, and neither of them could explain why.
And Grandfather repeatedly told me not to try anything with Great-grandfather's wine gourd, otherwise, he would be angry.
As I got older, not only did my curiosity not diminish, it actually grew stronger.
Finally, when I was 16, I secretly took my great-grandfather's wine gourd while he was asleep.
When I opened it, I was gobsmacked. Because except for a small stone, there was nothing inside, not even a drop of wine.
While I was still in a daze, Great-grandfather woke up.
When I saw Great-grandfather awake, I was agitated and did not know what to do.
But he first looked at the wine gourd in my hand and then at the stunned me, then laughed suddenly and said, ..
.. “Boy, I have waited so many years, and finally someone has taken my wine gourd.”
What my great-grandfather said made me even more confused. What was he saying? Why didn’t I understand?
Great-grandfather patted the seat beside him, told me to sit down, and started telling the story of the wine gourd as if talking to himself.
When he was young, it was still an era when people lived at the mercy of the elements.
One year, there was a big drought, and it didn't rain for several months.
Crops were destroyed by the drought. Many people died of hunger because there was not enough food.
Our family was big, with several dozen people, including pregnant women and newborn babies.
The young men of the family looked at the children crying with hunger and the pregnant women with nothing to eat and were very anxious.
Great-grandfather then stepped forward and told everyone that they couldn't just sit around waiting.
They must take the initiative to go out and find food.
Because the village was close to a mountain, he planned to take the young men of the family up the mountain to try their luck.
It was said that the mountain had fierce animals and was dangerous.
It is often said that drinking gives you courage.
In order not to be afraid, Great-grandfather hung a wine gourd from home on him.
Then he took more than a dozen young people up the mountain.
After going up the mountain, they started looking and slowly found a lot of food: drought-resistant plants, starved animals, and so on.
They were very happy and filled all the bags they had brought with them. However, no one noticed that it was already getting dark.
After they finished loading and were getting ready to go down the mountain, they noticed that it was already dark.
They had no way to tell the direction and couldn't find the way they came. Everyone was very anxious.
At this point, Great-grandfather told everyone not to panic because on the way he had left small stones to mark the way as he walked.
Everyone just needed to patiently look for the small stones and follow the stones down the mountain.
After everyone calmed down and started looking, they, sure enough, found the small stones and quickly went down the mountain.
When Great-grandfather arrived at the foot of the mountain, he took the last small stone and put it in the wine gourd.
He wanted to pass on the spirit of not getting flustered when problems occur, ..
.. enjoying challenges, and being brave to the most outstanding person in the family.
Great-grandfather not only saved the people on the mountain, but also the people at home, so everyone admired him very much.
Because people respected him, although they were curious about his wine gourd, ..
.. no one dared to ask, and no one had the courage to find out the secret of the wine gourd.
Today, I secretly took his wine gourd, showing that I am a person who dares to take on challenges and is willing to try things.
So he decided to tell me the secret of the wine gourd.
He also gave the wine gourd to me, hoping that I will continue to maintain a curious and explorative spirit as I grow up.
After hearing what Great-grandfather said, I was very pleased with myself.
Didn't this mean that I was the most outstanding person in the family?
